heading: Our USPs as a Facebook ads agency

paragraphs.html: Smart targeting, tested creative and clear numbers. That is how we make ad budgets work harder.

items.title: Customer Satisfaction
items.text: We treat your ad budget like our own and keep you informed about how every campaign is doing.

items.title: Data-Driven Decisions
items.text: We make changes based on results, not guesses, so spend moves to the ads that perform.

items.title: 100% Custom Campaigns
items.text: Every account gets its own audiences, creative and funnel built around your business goals.

items.title: Transparent Reporting
items.text: You see your spend, results and cost per lead in simple reports, with no hidden fees.
